Flower Punctuation Mark Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Flower Punctuation Mark because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2055, which you can use as ⁕ in HTML, \2055 in CSS, or type with Alt+8277 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Flower Punctuation Mark is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2055 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Flower Punctuation Mark has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⁕ or the hex escape ⁕.

How to type flower punctuation mark on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 2 7 7 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8277.
  4. Release Alt. The Flower Punctuation Mark character (⁕) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type flower punctuation mark on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Flower Punctuation Mark. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Flower Punctuation Mark" and click the character to insert it.

How to use flower punctuation mark in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2055"; ()
  • Python: \u2055 or chr(0x2055)
  • JavaScript: \u2055 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2055)
  • JSON: "\u2055"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⁕?

No legacy Alt code exists for Flower Punctuation Mark because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2055 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⁕ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⁕, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8277 not work?

Alt+8277 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Flower Punctuation Mark?

The Unicode codepoint for Flower Punctuation Mark is U+2055. You can use this value in HTML as ⁕, in CSS as \2055, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⁕ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2055, then click it.
